products.name: Gentle Hydrating Shampoo
products.description: A mild daily shampoo for cleansing without leaving the hair feeling stripped.

products.name: Repair Conditioner
products.description: A smoothing conditioner made for dry, frizzy, or easily tangled hair.

products.name: Intensive Hair Mask
products.description: A weekly treatment for hair that feels dry, rough, or overworked.

products.name: Smoothing Serum
products.description: A lightweight finishing serum that helps keep frizz manageable.

products.name: Nourishing Hair Oil
products.description: A light hair oil for adding softness and shine to the lengths and ends.

products.name: Wide-Tooth Comb
products.description: A simple detangling comb suited for use on damp or dry hair.

products.name: Avela Everyday Fresh Shampoo
products.description: A 250 mL wash-day shampoo for hair that feels weighed down between washes. Lather at the roots, rinse well, and follow with conditioner on the lengths.

products.name: Avela Soft Curl Shampoo
products.description: A 250 mL shampoo for a gentle start to a curl-care routine. Work through wet roots and rinse before conditioning; intended for curls and coils that feel dry.

products.name: Avela Light Wash Shampoo
products.description: A 250 mL everyday shampoo for straight or wavy hair that prefers a light wash. Massage a small amount into wet roots, rinse thoroughly, and condition the ends as needed.

products.name: Avela Lightweight Conditioner
products.description: A 250 mL rinse-out conditioner for lengths that need slip without a rich finish. Spread through mid-lengths and ends, then rinse thoroughly.

products.name: Avela Curl Comfort Conditioner
products.description: A 250 mL conditioner for unhurried wash-day detangling. Smooth over wet curls in sections and use fingers or a wide-tooth comb before rinsing.

products.name: Avela Soft Lengths Mask
products.description: A 200 mL rinse-out mask for a weekly care step when the lengths feel rough. Apply after shampooing, leave briefly, and rinse; follow the routine that suits your hair.

products.name: Avela Wash-Day Detangling Cream
products.description: A 200 mL rinse-out cream for working through knots on wet hair. Apply in sections and gently detangle from the ends upward before rinsing.

products.name: Avela Daily Leave-In Milk
products.description: A 150 mL leave-in styling milk for damp lengths. Start with a small amount, spread evenly, and let hair air-dry or style as usual; avoid applying directly to the scalp.

products.name: Avela Sleek Finish Serum
products.description: A 50 mL finishing serum for smoothing the look of flyaways. Rub a small amount between palms and lightly work over dry lengths and ends.

products.name: Avela Lightweight Finishing Oil
products.description: A 50 mL hair oil for a restrained finishing step. Use a few drops on the ends and add more only if needed; intended for shine and a softer feel rather than scalp treatment.

products.name: Avela Soft Ends Hair Oil
products.description: A 60 mL oil for dry-feeling lengths and ends. Warm a little in the palms and distribute through sections; skip the roots if they already feel oily.

products.name: Avela Sectioning Clips Set
products.description: Four reusable clips for holding sections apart while washing, detangling, or styling. Open each clip fully before placing it and release gently to avoid pulling.

products.name: Avela Microfiber Hair Wrap
products.description: A lightweight wrap for gathering wet hair after washing. Squeeze out excess water first, wrap loosely, and fasten without twisting tightly at the roots.

products.name: Avela Satin Scrunchie Trio
products.description: Three soft fabric-covered hair ties for loose ponytails and buns. Choose a comfortable hold and avoid winding the tie tightly around the same section.
